selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural and religious classification of the structure as an altar, distinguishing it from general furniture or other religious artifacts.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex multi-layered altarpiece, ensuring columns and tiers are physically grounded and not melting into the background.
To check for boundary bleeding between the intricate carvings and the background, and to ensure the draped cloths have coherent topology without impossible folds or fusion.
To assess the rendering quality of the complex textures (gold leaf, stone, fabric) and check for subtle AI-generated noise or smearing in high-detail areas.

focus_areas: Structural coherence of the multi-tiered altarpiece

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intricate details of the altarpiece. AI often struggles with complex, repetitive ornamental patterns, causing them to melt or become nonsensical upon close inspection. Verify that the columns actually support the weight above them and that the draped cloths in the foreground have physically plausible folds. Check for any 'ghosting' or double edges around the high-contrast gold elements against the dark background.
